findings.title: Panel row measure undercounts the draw pass by 3 rows — max scroll can never reach the drop-log tail
findings.evidence: measure: `rows := i32(2) // header` / `rows += 2 // drops` / `rows += 2 // crisis` — draw emits 3 header rows (title, glob, hash), 3 drop rows (hdr, counters, ratio), 3 crisis rows (hdr, sat, pool)
findings.detail: The scroll clamp clamp(scroll, 0, total-visible) uses the undercount; when content exceeds the 50-row viewport the last 3 rows (bottom of the drop log — briefing scope item 5, the scrollable alarm feed) are unreachable. Violates the proc's own 'MUST agree row-for-row' invariant.
findings.fix: Count the hash row, the ratio line, and the pool_line crisis row in noc_panel_rows (or derive the count from the draw pass); keep the invariant comment honest.

findings.title: run-dev.sh's documented --stats-out pass-through is dead: ARGS never forwarded to the app; build line gets one empty-string arg when set
findings.evidence: `odin build app -define:PP_DEBUG=true -out:bin/app-dev "${ARGS[@]+}"` then `PP_NOC_E2E=1 ./bin/app-dev` / `./bin/app-dev` — no "$@"/${ARGS[@]} on either run line
findings.detail:
Header documents '--stats-out

# pass-through (the app's telemetry flag)' but flags are dropped from the run; when ARGS is non-empty the build line instead receives a single empty-string argument (verified in bash: argc=1), which odin rejects or misparses.
findings.fix: Run `./bin/app-dev "${ARGS[@]+"${ARGS[@]}"}"` (or plain "$@") on both run lines; drop the broken build-line expansion.

findings.title: overlay-check .t1 sidecar only byte-matches the golden for full-length, pause-free captures (paused ticks unhashed; partial captures truncate)
findings.evidence: overlay loop: `if paused_at(...) { free_all(...); continue }` — run.odin's golden driver instead appends a per-wall-tick hash while paused ('paused state STABLE' pin). Reproduced: `overlay-check pause 100000ms` -> 1810 hashes vs goldens/pause.t1 2000; 10000ms partial capture -> 200 vs 240.
findings.detail: The AC3 byte-identity proof holds for the PR's shipped proof (qos_contention 12000ms — cmp-equal, independently re-verified) but the verb produces non-comparable sidecars for paused demos and partial captures, with no guard or warning.
findings.fix: Hash paused wall ticks like run.odin (state-stable pin) and/or compare prefix-wise + fail loud when cap_ms < demo length or pauses exist.

findings.title: Rejection accounting is lossy: the latch only runs while the panel is ON, and dedups on (tick, kind)
findings.evidence: `if app.overlay_on && app.run_live { rnd.noc_feed_scan(...); if app.input.last_reject != .None && (app.input.reject_tick != app.noc_reject_tick || app.input.last_reject != app.noc_reject_kind) { rnd.noc_feed_reject(...) } }`
findings.detail: N rejections made with the panel hidden collapse to <=1 at next reveal (only last_reject/reject_tick persist); two same-kind rejections within one 20Hz tick count once. Drop counters catch up on reveal (events); rejections do not — the 'REJECTED, not dropped: N' line undercounts.
findings.fix: Scan rejections unconditionally in PP_DEBUG builds (drop events already are), or accumulate reject counts at the executor where each rejection is observable.

findings.title: Out-of-roster class drop is double-counted: reason bucket AND drop_other both increment, inflating total + ratio
findings.evidence: reason switch increments drop_e9 (say), then `if u32(e.class) < NOC_MAX_CLASSES { ... } else { f.drop_other += 1 }` — one event, two counters
findings.detail: E9+E22+other can exceed the Packet_Dropped count and the ratio denominator uses that total. Unreachable with the current catalog (roster << 64) and pinned as the anomaly signal by noc_feed_class_beyond_table — but the panel 'total' line then lies about the very anomaly it surfaces.
findings.fix: Count out-of-roster classes in a separate anomaly counter (not drop_other), or exempt them from the total/ratio math.

findings.title: '/3s' rolling rate freezes after quiet periods — the rings only roll when a drop event arrives
findings.evidence: ring_roll is called only inside noc_feed_fold_drop; after >=60 dropless ticks noc_feed_rate_total still sums the pre-quiet window's slots
findings.detail: The spec's I/O matrix says 'rates = last 60 ticks only'; after a quiet period the labeled /3s readout keeps showing the frozen last-drop window — stale diagnosis data in the exact 'why am I losing NOW' use case.
findings.fix: Roll the rings to the current sim tick at draw/scan time (pass stats.tick), zero-filling elapsed slots.

findings.title: NOC panel forks draw_panel_card's chrome inline with drifted alpha values
findings.evidence: fork: `rl.DrawRectangle(..., rl.Color{255,252,244,230})` + border `{51,65,79,60}` — shared draw_panel_card: card alpha 235, border alpha 40
findings.detail: Spec Always-constraint: 'SHARE, never fork: reuse draw_text_c / draw_panel_card'. The copy already drifted (230/60 vs 235/40) — the exact fork the constraint forbids.
findings.fix: Call draw_panel_card(v, NOC_PANEL_X-8, NOC_PANEL_Y-10, NOC_PANEL_W+16, NOC_PANEL_H+20).

findings.title: PR-body e2e claim 'differs by exactly the panel rect (233,120 px)' overstates — 3,473 px also differ outside the card
findings.evidence: Pixel-diff of the committed captures: total 236,593 differing px; in-card (900..1275, 86..705 = the drawn 376x620 card) exactly 233,120; outside 3,473 px across x 49..899 (sim advanced 120 frames between the frame-120 ON and frame-240 OFF captures). Fresh re-run reproduced both captures sha256-identically.
findings.detail: The proof itself is solid and reproducible (re-ran tools/run-dev.sh --e2e: byte-identical artifacts), but 'exactly' is false — normal game motion between captures also differs. Say 'the panel card rect (233,120 px) + ~3.5k px of ordinary 2s game motion'.
findings.fix: Correct the wording in the PR body (no code change).

findings.title: Further measure/draw drift on conditional rows: sel_pipe counted +4 but draws 0-4; empty-state placeholder rows uncounted; class-roster filter skipped in measure
findings.evidence: measure `if sel_pipe >= 0 { rows += 4 }` vs draw guards (`pipe_slot` ok, stats-loop break); `if shown_events == 0 { cur = noc_row(... "(no events yet...") }` adds an unmeasured row
findings.detail: Beyond the constant -3: conditional sections drift the clamp by a row or two depending on state. Dev-tool cosmetic.
findings.fix: Fold into the same measure-pass fix as the -3 correction.

findings.evidence: `// v2-noc: the F-key debug surface (the merged 5.7 + NOC overlay) draws` — poll.odin gates `.D`, panel title reads 'DEBUG OVERLAY (D)', README says D

findings.evidence: line 72: '...e2e auto-drive (PP_NOC_E2E=1: inject Key_Press{.F} after the polls...' (same line's first half says 'D kept as the overlay key'); line 109: 'expected: compiles; F toggles the panel'

findings.title: Drop-log stale bundle slots: out-of-range ids render 'map-wide' (the E22 label) instead of the promised 'gone'; occupied renumbered slots misanchor pipe/endpoints/lane
findings.evidence: `if e.bundle == pp.NO_BUNDLE || int(e.bundle) >= len(bundles.bundle_lo) { return ... "map-wide" }` — the 'gone' branch only fires for in-range slots with no live pipe; resolution reads the CURRENT bundle table
findings.detail: A shrunk bundle array sends stale E9 rows down the map-wide branch; a renumbered occupied slot shows plausible-but-wrong ids. Edge-case mislabels in a diagnostic feed.
findings.fix: Separate NO_BUNDLE from out-of-range ('gone'), and consider tick-stamping the roster or flagging renumbered rows.

findings.title: Noc_Feed.crisis_last_cause is written but never read
findings.evidence: grep: only `f.crisis_last_cause = e.cause` — the readout prints bundle/pipe/class only; no test reads it
findings.detail: Dead field in the feed struct.
findings.fix: Print it in the Saturated_Bundle line or drop the field.

findings.title: Wheel scroll truncates fractional deltas — trackpad scrolling does nothing
findings.evidence: `if w := rl.GetMouseWheelMove(); w != 0 { app.noc_scroll = max(0, app.noc_scroll - i32(w)) }` — i32(0.5) == 0
findings.detail: GetMouseWheelMove is fractional on trackpads/high-res wheels; sub-1.0 deltas pass the !=0 test then truncate to zero. Mouse wheels (±1.0) work.
findings.fix: Accumulate a f32 remainder instead of truncating per event.

findings.title: PP_NOC_E2E truthiness: any non-empty value (e.g. PP_NOC_E2E=0) arms the scripted key-injection/auto-exit drive
findings.detail: Dev-build-only surprise (=0/=false still activates scripted D presses + auto-exit); harmless in release (compiled out).

findings.title: The rejection dedup latch (tick||kind condition) is the feed path's only untested branch logic
findings.evidence: noc_feed_reject counting is unit-pinned; the PP_DEBUG-gated latch deciding WHEN a reject is new has no test
findings.detail: A regression double-counts or drops rejections silently. Pairs with the lossy-accounting warning.
findings.fix: Extract the latch as a pure helper and pin it (it is untestable inline under gate-2 as-is).

findings.title: Scroll clamp / noc_panel_rows-vs-draw row-agreement invariant has no test (PP_DEBUG-gated, unreachable by gate-2 unit tests)
findings.evidence: nothing verifies the 'MUST agree row-for-row' invariant or the clamp; the drift warnings shipped precisely because of that
findings.detail: Measure/draw drift is invisible to the suite. (The ungated feed is well-pinned — 11 tests.)
findings.fix: Emit the row count from an ungated pure helper both passes share, and test THAT.

findings.title: Rejection-kind label map (17 Edit_Error cases) untested — taxonomy pins cover Drop_Reason + lanes but not the rejection labels
findings.evidence: noc_feed_taxonomy_labels pins E9/E22/?? + lane letters; noc_edit_error_label sits inside the PP_DEBUG gate with no test
findings.detail: A mislabeled rejection kind ships silently.
findings.fix: Move the label map ungated (pure string switch) and pin it like the others.
